caption: The drawing depicts a garment, specifically a short-sleeved, open-front dress or robe intended for a small child. The garment is predominantly off-white in color and features vertical pinstripes running throughout the fabric. The edges of the robe, including the neckline, front opening, sleeve cuffs, and hem, are bordered with decorative trim embroidered with small pink and red flower patterns. The sleeves are short, loose, and slightly flared, and the overall shape of the garment is wide at the bottom, giving it an A-line appearance. The background is a plain, textured grayish-brown surface, with the garment centered and shown in a flat, frontal view. The artwork is bordered by a light beige frame.
title: Boy's Coat
